title: Claude Code plugin commands are prefixed with the plugin name
trigger: when naming DD slash commands or skills, or changing the name in .claude-plugin/plugin.json
behavior_delta: Expect every plugin skill to appear as /<plugin name>:<skill name>. The plugin is named deltadictum, so a skill named review appears as /deltadictum:review, not /dd:review. Getting /dd:* requires plugin.json name dd, which changes the marketplace install id (dd@deltadictum) and needs reinstalling for existing users; the npm package name is separate.
what: Expect every plugin skill to appear as /<plugin name>:<skill name>. The plugin is named deltadictum, so a skill named review appears as /deltadictum:review, not /dd:review. Getting /dd:* requires plugin.json name dd, which changes the marketplace install id (dd@deltadictum) and needs reinstalling for existing users; the npm package name is separate.
why: The user asked for /dd:* commands on 2026-09-24; the prefix comes from the plugin manifest, not from the skill or MCP server name, so naming the skills alone does not produce it.

evidence_refs.summary: The plugin name is deltadictum; the MCP server inside it is dd.
The Commands section records the rename decision.
